BEFORE YOU BEGIN

ToneMagic is for relaxation, meditation and enjoyment. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any illness or condition.

The tone descriptions share the history and the traditional beliefs that go with each tone. They are not proven medical effects. For any health concern, please see a qualified health professional.

Please listen safely: start with the volume low and raise it slowly, take breaks, and stop if you feel any discomfort. Do not listen to brainwave beats while driving or operating machinery. If you have epilepsy or a seizure disorder, check with your doctor first.
